avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer may significantly reduce montelukast plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products if mood support needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 induction substantially decreases montelukast levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; if antimicrobial therapy required, consult prescriber for dose adjustment consideration

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce montelukast exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor asthma control; report any decreased symptom management to healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction may marginally affect montelukast levels
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; maintain consistent dosing and monitor for reduced effectiveness

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase montelukast plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; if regularly ingested, monitor for increased side effects

monitoring_notes: Montelukast is extensively metabolized via hepatic CYP enzymes; monitor for loss of efficacy with strong enzyme inducers or increased side effects with inhibitors. No significant food restrictions; bioavailability is not substantially affected by food intake.
